name: Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 3
summary: Dive into the latest installment of the “Battle Operation” series, the epic free-to-play team combat game set in the Mobile Suit Gundam multiverse. Enlist as a mercenary, pilot legendary mobile suits, and fight together to conquer the battlefield in Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 3!
